## Process

## Checklist

- [ ] One new folder named after the process, containing `PROCESS.md` and `marketplace.json`.
- [ ] `name` in `PROCESS.md` matches the folder name.
- [ ] Written as a general template: no real names, emails, customer data, credentials or internal links.
- [ ] Every irreversible action (payments, deletions, sending to customers) has a person approve it first.
- [ ] Agent instructions never ask for passwords or secrets, or send data anywhere the adopter didn't choose.
- [ ] It has **Before adoption** and **Rehearsal cases** sections.
- [ ] I wrote this, or have the right to share it, and agree to license it under this repository's license.
